title: Lionel Hampton as a Christian Scientist
summary: Thomas says Hampton is a Christian Scientist reportedly healed of drinking, who showed him how to do the lessons.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Of course. Yeah, okay. Now, this is advice. You were talking to me some about if... Do you know any Christian Science great musician that you can label, who used Science in...
I know one, but I don't know how much he used Science -- but he was a great musician.
Because I finally met the practitioner that's supposed to have healed him of drinking. I think he was a good student. I don't know whether he went and had his class or not.
Will you send a couple over here to me?
I finally met Lionel right after I had had this trip to Chicago. That's when I bought my books, and I

had to learn how to do the lessons. So we was going to some town. We met in a town somewhere in Virginia or somewhere. He had to be in town. So I was so glad to see him, so I told him I had just taken up studying Christian Science. So he showed me how to do the lessons. Because I hadn't done a lesson before. I was just reading pamphlets and things on it. Then I heard a lecture that got me into studying it.
